# Repair fixed window minima

For numeric input values and width k>0, return the minimum in each consecutive full window. Return [] when k exceeds length; include the final full window.

The CLI accepts one JSON array argument and returns the corresponding JSON result array. Preserve the original public tests, CLI, and README. Add a new discovered regression test without changing original test bytes. Run the exact public verification command read-only after your final edit: `go test ./...`. No external dependencies are needed.
